2027-01-26.title: Saints Timothy and Titus, Bishops
readings: Rekindle the gift of God that is within you
Proclaim his marvellous deeds to all the nations
Whoever does the will of God is my brother and sister and mother
2027-01-26.alt: Memorial. In India, Republic Day: the Mass for the Nation may be used where the bishops permit. Liturgical colour: white.
2027-01-26.verse: for this reason I remind you to rekindle the gift of God that is within you through the laying on of my hands;
theo: The day after Paul's conversion, the Church honours two of his closest companions, Timothy and Titus. Paul writes to Timothy with fatherly warmth: “I am reminded of your sincere faith, a faith that lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice.” And he gives him a charge: “rekindle the gift of God that is within you… for God did not give us a spirit of cowardice, but rather a spirit of power and of love and of self-discipline.” Grace received at ordination, or at Baptism and Confirmation, can grow cold; it must be fanned into flame.

In the Gospel his mother and brothers come and, standing outside, ask for him; Jesus looks at those sitting around him: “Here are my mother and my brothers! Whoever does the will of God is my brother and sister and mother.” This does not reject Mary, who more than anyone did God's will; it opens his family to all who obey. Today India celebrates Republic Day. As citizens and as members of God's family, we pray for our country, for justice and harmony among all its peoples, and for those who govern.
outline: Ask: is there a gift of God in you that has grown cold?
Doing the will of God; praying for our nation.
“Rekindle the gift of God that is within you.”
live: Use one gift you have neglected: music, teaching, prayer, service.
Pray for the nation and its leaders on Republic Day.
2027-01-26.prayer: O God, who adorned Saints Timothy and Titus with apostolic virtues, grant, through the intercession of them both, that, living justly and devoutly in this present age, we may merit to reach our heavenly homeland. Bless our nation on this Republic Day with justice, peace and harmony. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
altar: The laying on of hands that made Timothy a bishop continues in the Church today; through it Christ gives us the Eucharist.

quick: Faith is handed on in families, as with Timothy.
Rekindle the gift of God within you.

2027-01-26.question: What gift of God in me needs to be rekindled?

family.explain: Timothy learned about Jesus from his grandmother and mother. God gives us a spirit of power and love, not fear!
family.intention: We pray for India on Republic Day, and for our grandparents.
family.ask: Ask: “What can we thank our grandparents for?”

illus: A retired teacher in Kozhikode had stopped playing the organ after her husband died. On the memorial of Timothy and Titus her parish priest read Paul's words about rekindling the gift and asked her to play again. She now teaches children to sing at Mass. She says: the fire was not dead, only covered with ash.

pm.open: Lord, rekindle the gifts you have given us, and make us your family by doing your will. Amen.
share: A faith that lived first in your grandmother (2 Timothy 1:5). Who handed the faith on to me?
Rekindle the gift of God (2 Timothy 1:6). Which gift have I let grow cold?
Whoever does the will of God (Mark 3:35). Do I do God's will?
interc: For bishops, successors of the apostles.
For grandparents and parents who hand on the faith.
For India on Republic Day: for justice, peace and harmony.
For our group, that our gifts may serve the Church.
pm.close: Father, through Timothy and Titus you built up your Church. Rekindle our gifts and bless our nation. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, today we honour Timothy and Titus, Paul's faithful companions. Paul writes to Timothy: I am reminded of your sincere faith, a faith that lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice (2 Timothy 1:5).

Then he urges him: rekindle the gift of God that is within you; for God did not give us a spirit of cowardice, but rather a spirit of power and of love and of self-discipline (2 Timothy 1:6–7). The gifts of God can grow cold; we must fan them into flame.
In the Gospel Jesus says: whoever does the will of God is my brother and sister and mother (Mark 3:35). Mary is first among those who did God's will, and Jesus opens his family to all who obey.
Today is Republic Day in India. As members of God's family, let us pray for our nation, for justice and harmony among all its peoples, and for those who govern. Amen.
kids: Children, Timothy's grandmother and mother taught him about Jesus. Thank God for your family, and pray for our country today!
